proposed_connector.name: fdic_call_reports.upstart_partner_aggregate
proposed_connector.description: Aggregate count of FDIC-insured banks and NCUA-insured credit unions reporting an active personal-lending program against an Upstart-like partner indicator (e.g., references in regulator filings, call-report partner-program flags, FFIEC partner-bank disclosures).
proposed_connector.sample_invocation: Combine FDIC BankFind + NCUA credit-union registry queries filtered to banks publicly disclosed as Upstart partners (no consolidated registry exists); we'd verify only the floor (named partners) since no single source enumerates 'all Upstart partner banks'.
proposed_connector.rationale: The 100+ partner count is a marketing aggregate, not a registered relationship. No registry directly enumerates 'Upstart partner banks'; we can only verify named partners via FDIC BankFind / NCUA, so a custom roll-up connector is required to attempt floor adjudication.
proposed_connector.completeness: Only counts named/publicly-disclosed partners; cannot certify the full >100 count.

claims.extraction_notes: Headline partner count is a marketing aggregate without a clean registry analog; likely UNVERIFIABLE in scoring. Cohort calibration note flags exactly this kind of claim as expected-unverifiable.

claims.claim_text: In the year ended December 31, 2023, Upstart's top three lending partners collectively originated 80% of loans and accounted for 63% of total revenue.
claims.source_quote: In the year ended December 31, 2023, our top three lending partners originated 80% of the loans facilitated through our marketplace and fees received from these lending partners accounted for 63% of our total revenue.
claims.subject: Upstart top three lending partners
claims.predicate: originated share of marketplace loans / share of revenue
claims.extraction_notes: 10-K does not name the top three partners; UPST's historically publicly-known partners are Cross River, FinWise, and Customers. Call Reports' LNCONOTH (other consumer loans) lets us sanity-check that aggregate consumer-loan portfolios across these three are large enough to plausibly carry 80% of UPST's 2023 originations. This is a soft consistency check, not strict adjudication: UPST share within each bank's book is not separable.

claims.claim_text: Upstart completed an asset-backed securitization transaction in July 2023 that was consolidated in its financial statements, contributing 4% of 2023 originations as collateral.
claims.source_quote: the remaining 4% were contributed as collateral to the securitization transaction completed in July 2023, which we have consolidated in our financial statements.
claims.subject: Upstart Holdings, Inc.
claims.extraction_notes: ABS-15G / 10-D filings from UPST or its securitization-issuing subsidiary in mid-2023 corroborate the issuance. If no ABS filings cluster in summer 2023 under UPST's CIK, the securitization may have been issued by an affiliated SPV under a different CIK; absence at UPST's CIK is therefore not necessarily contradictory.
